def count_vowels(s):
    vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
    count = 0
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n):
        if s[i] in vowels:
            continue
        left_vowel = i > 0 and s[i - 1] in vowels
        right_vowel = i < n - 1 and s[i + 1] in vowels
        if left_vowel or right_vowel:
            count += 1
    return count
